spans.s:
तुल (कि) तोलति तुलति तोलयति
तुलयति 1. 10.
a. To weigh.

तूल (लं) 1.
n. The mulberry; æther.
m. n. Cotton.
f. (ला-ली)
a. A wick
for a lamp. (ली) Indigo; wea-
ver's or painter's brush.

तुल-सारिणी (णी) 3.
f. A quiver.

तुलसी (सी) 3.
f. Holy basil (Ocy-
mum sanctum).

तुला-कोटि (टिः-टी) 2. 3.
f. An or-
nament of the feet; a certain
weight; a hundred million.

तुला-कोश (शः) 1.
m. A sort of or-
deal by being weighed.

तुला-धर (रः) 1.
m. The sun.

तुला_धार (रः) 1.
m. Libra; string or
beam of a balance; a trader.

तुला-परीक्षा (क्षा) 1.
f. Ordeal by be-
ing weighed in the balance.

तुला-पुरुष (षः) 1.
m. A man weighed.

तुलापुरुष-दान (नं) 1.
n. A gift of
gold, the weight of the donor.

तुला-प्रग्रह (हः) 1.
m. String of a ba-
lance; beam of a balance.

तुलामान (नं) 1.
n. Measure by weight.

तुला-वीज (जं) 1.
n. Gunja berry; a
weight rather more than a grain;
Abrus precatorius.

तुला-सूत्र (त्रं) 1.
n. String of a balance.

तुलि (लिः-ली) 2. 3.
f. A brush, ei-
ther weaver's or painter's.

तुलि, फला (ला) 1.
f. Silk-cotton tree.

तूलि (लिः) 2.
f. A painter's brush.

तुलिका (का) 1.
f. A small bird said
to resemble the wagtail.

तूलिका (का) 1.
f. A pencil, painter's
brush; a matrass or quilt; in-
got; mould; dipping rod; wick.

तुलित (तः-ता-तं)
p. Equalled; com-
pared; weighed.

तुल्य (ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं)
a. Like.

तुल्य-ता (ता) 1.
f. Likeness.

तुल्य-पान (नं) 1.
n. Drinking together.

तुल्य-बल (लः-ला-लं)
a. Of equal
strength, or force.

तुल्य-भावन (नं) 1.
n. Combination
of like series (in calculation).

तुल्य-योगिता (ता) 1.
f. Mistaking
one thing for another, from an
exact likeness in them.

तुल्य-रूप (पः-पा-पी-पं)
a. Like.

तुल्य-वृत्ति (त्तिः-त्तिः-त्ति)
a. Of like trade.

तुल्य-शुद्धि (द्धिः) 2.
f. Equal sub-
traction, or transposition.

तुल्या_कृति (तिः-तिः-ति)
a. Alike.

तूल् (क) तूलयति 10.
a. To dismiss; to
ascertain quantity. Also तूलति.

तूलक (कं) 1.
n. Cotton.

तूल-कर्म्मक (कं) 1.
n. A bow which
is used for cleaning cotton.

तूल-नाली (ली) 3.
f. A thick roll of
cotton, prepared for spinning.

तूल-पिचु (चुः) 2.
m. Cotton.

तूल-शर्करा (रा) 1.
f. A pod or seed
of the cotton plant.

तूल-सेचन (नं) 1.
n. Spinning.

तूलिनी (नी) 3.
f. The silk-cotton tree.
